milestones.detail: Foundation and portal scaffold exist; four remote CI checks passed at 722648f. Not merged.
Registry, acquisition and schema tooling exist at 1fcea75. Dataset permissions and availability remain constraints.
Baselines exist at ca0c7a4; four remote CI checks passed. PR reports development runs only; run artifacts are not present in this checkout.
No M3 remote ref or PR in audited inventory; no reportable research results in the portal index.
No M4 remote ref or PR in audited inventory; no validated alignment, rolling-origin or domain-shift artifacts.

experiments.title: Cross-dataset generalization
experiments.implementation: Source-only frozen-fit primitive; no certified dataset alignment or campaign runner.
blockers: No pair of locally available, licensed, fingerprint-verified datasets.
Packet and flow features lack an approved semantic/unit/granularity contract.

experiments.title: Chronological drift and adaptation
experiments.implementation: Delayed-label prequential primitive with frozen, periodic and simple error-triggered policies.
blockers: Timestamp, session separation and initial-label availability are unverified.
Simple error trigger is not a validated drift detector; detection delay and false-alarm campaign pending.

experiments.title: Offline defensive robustness
experiments.implementation: Bounded aggregate-only random measurement-noise sensitivity utility.
blockers: Reviewed independent continuous fields and physical constraints unavailable.
No real-data robustness measurements; no operational evasion claims.

experiments.title: Unknown-attack recognition
experiments.implementation: Held-out family isolation guard and known-validation threshold utilities.
blockers: Attack-family ontology and family-disjoint partitions unavailable.
Synthetic outlier smoke exercise is not unknown-attack recognition evidence.

experiments.title: SHAP feature stability
experiments.implementation: Actual TreeSHAP smoke path and tie-aware top-k Jaccard utility.
blockers: No verified real models or aligned feature windows.
SHAP stability is descriptive, not causal evidence.

experiments.title: Resource benchmarks
experiments.implementation: Warm batch latency percentiles, throughput and CPU-time utility.
blockers: No real fitted pipeline or representative edge hardware.
Isolated peak-RSS and full training-cost benchmarks not implemented.

experiments.title: Controlled ablations and intervals
experiments.implementation: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of macro-F1 deltas.
blockers: Full real-data multi-seed ablation campaign not executed.
Block length and analysis units require source-validation evidence.
